protocol.aggregation: No pooled MAE: each window uses its own train-only target normalizer.
protocol.interpretation: Exploratory retrospective evaluation on already inspected data, not untouched final tests.

audit.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of previously inspected test data; no fitting or model selection.
limitations: Recall-bearing matched population; not representative of all vehicles.
MAE is not an individual confidence interval.
Small-group threshold is a reporting convention, not a significance test.
Subgroup errors do not establish causality or homogeneous performance.

selection.reason: Random Forest reduce el MAE de Ridge en 10.5% y también obtiene el menor MAE entre los candidatos elegibles.
selection.rule: Random Forest is selected only when validation MAE improves on Ridge by > threshold.

target_normalizer.semantics: 100 indicates lower estimated propensity to NHTSA safety recalls, not general mechanical reliability.

metrics.target_scale: 0-100 (100 = menor propensión histórica estimada a recalls)
